clues.title: Coverage: over fifty small separate pieces
text: The coverage in Greenland is divided into well over fifty small disjoint parts, with different weather conditions, seasons, landmarks and so on. Although the largest concentration is found on the southern half of the **west coast**, coverage can be found scattered along a lot of the coast. Since differentiating between some of them requires a lot of technical information, such as the position of the sun or clouds, this guide will only cover the parts with clear distinctive features, such as a unique Street View vehicle or an easily recognizable mountain.

Because of the limited coverage, this guide will be structured differently than most other guides. It will be divided into two main sections: one for **land coverage** and one for **boat coverage**. These two sections will each be divided into step 2, for larger towns and boats found in multiple locations, and step 3, for smaller settlements and boats found only in one place.
clues.summary: Coverage is split into well over fifty small separate parts, mostly on the southern half of the west coast but scattered along much of the coast. Parts differ in weather, season and landmarks, and many are hard to tell apart.

clues.title: Camera: Gen 3 trekker on many vehicles
text: All coverage in Greenland was taken with a **Generation 3 trekker camera**, which was often attached to a variety of vehicles.
clues.summary: All coverage uses the older Gen 3 trekker camera (blurrier, softer colours), mounted on all sorts of vehicles.

clues.title: Google car: odd one-off vehicles
text: Most locations with coverage will have their own odd and **unique Street View vehicles**, ranging from a [red tractor](https://maps.app.goo.gl/EHBFXWN9aCUpivDLA) to a snowmobile with a [large box](https://maps.app.goo.gl/uZLdPkeR8AV62wox6) at the front.
clues.summary: Most covered places have their own odd, unique vehicle, from a red tractor to a snowmobile with a big box on the front.

clues.title: Houses: small colourful wooden houses, sparse
text: Greenlandic architecture mainly consists of small, **colourful**, simple looking **wooden **houses, which even in cities are typically placed quite sparsely. The major cities have some larger buildings, which normally look fairly minimalistic.
clues.summary: Small, colourful, simple wooden houses spaced quite far apart, even in cities. Larger cities have some bigger, plain buildings.

clues.title: Landscape: barren, no trees, snow, fjords
text: The Greenlandic landscape is very barren, with **no trees or taller vegetation **and often featuring snow. Mountains and hills are common, with very limited flat areas. On top of that, almost all coverage was taken in coastal areas, so fjords and visible coastlines are very common.

images.caption: Four views of gravel roads, rocky hills and a fjord with floating ice

clues.summary: Very barren with no trees or tall plants, often snowy. Hills and mountains are common, and flat land is rare. Nearly all coverage is on the coast, so fjords and coastlines are everywhere.

clues.title: Coverage: boat trekkers, many boat types
text: **Boat trekkers** are very common in Greenland, featuring a variety of different boats.
clues.summary: Boat trekkers are very common, on many different kinds of boats.

clues.title: Google car: grey Street View car in the
text: While Nuuk is most easily recognized by the **grey Street View car**, it can also be recognized by being the largest city by far.
clues.summary: The largest city is easiest to spot by its grey Street View car, and by simply being by far the biggest city.

clues.title: Google car: black snowmobile
text: The city of Sisimiut can be easily recognized by the black snowmobile with side mirrors **pointing straight up**. The coverage is generally very overcast and grey.
clues.summary: A black snowmobile with side mirrors pointing straight up, in very overcast, grey coverage (Sisimiut).

clues.title: Google car: green ATV, beige-hat driver
text: Most coverage in Ilulissat can be recognized by the green ATV with black bars and the driver wearing a **beige hat. **Note however that there are some [small sections](https://www.google.com/maps/@?api=1&map_action=pano&pano=MHgi-HGuMNFzyxbnwbMG9g&viewpoint=69.216044%2C-51.120939&heading=309.0825089308934&pitch=-31.444946001086684&fov=133.16482449375943#extra%5Btags%5D=mountains%3A+low&extra%5Btags%5D=car%3A+green%2C+no+%22m%C3%B6ssa%22&extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) where the driver does not wear it. The coverage is fairly sunny and bright.
clues.summary: A green ATV with black bars and a driver in a beige hat (a few parts without it), in fairly sunny, bright coverage (Ilulissat).

clues.title: Google car: red rectangular car, very sunny
text: Qaqortoq can be recognized by the **red rectangular car**. The coverage is extremely sunny and the area is greener and less barren than most of the country.
clues.summary: A red boxy car in extremely sunny coverage, greener and less barren than most of the country (Qaqortoq).

clues.title: Google car: windshield with red-white-black
text: The most noticeable feature of the coverage in Aasiaat is the windshield with a **shiny red, white and black **reflection. The large, round side mirrors can also be used to identify the town. The coverage is very sunny and has thick, thawing snow along most of the roads.
clues.summary: A windshield with a shiny red, white and black reflection and large round side mirrors. Very sunny, with thick melting snow along roads (Aasiaat).

clues.title: Google car: ATV with big grey handguards
text: The coverage in Tasiilaq can be recognized by the ATV with **large grey handguards** on either side. The coverage has a lot of very thin clouds and the area is somewhat green.
clues.summary: An ATV with large grey handguards on both sides, many very thin clouds and a somewhat green area (Tasiilaq).

clues.title: Landscape: sharp mountain north
text: Uummannaq has two distinctive features: a **sharp mountain** to the north and a green snowmobile with **large** **black side mirrors**. Neither of the two can be seen on all coverage but at least one can be seen on most.
clues.summary: Two giveaways: a sharp mountain to the north and a green snowmobile with big black side mirrors. Most coverage shows at least one (Uummannaq).

clues.title: Google car: thin antenna on right side
text: Narsaq can be identified by the **thin antenna** seen on the right side of the car. The coverage is very sunny and fairly green.

images.caption: Red circle zooms in on the thin antenna at the right of the blurred spot

clues.summary: A thin antenna on the right side of the car, in very sunny and fairly green coverage (Narsaq).

clues.title: Google car: tractor, overcast and snowy
text: The coverage in Maniitsoq was taken by a **tractor**, making it very recognizable. The coverage is overcast and fairly snowy.
clues.summary: Coverage was taken by a tractor, which is very recognisable. It is overcast and fairly snowy (Maniitsoq).

clues.title: Google car: driver in black hoodie, sunset
text: The coverage in Narsarsuaq can be recognized by the driver wearing a **black hoodie**. The coverage was taken close to sunset on a very sunny day. There is also a fair amount of small bushes along the road, which is somewhat unusual in Greenland.
clues.summary: Driver in a black hoodie, near sunset on a very sunny day, with small bushes along the road, which is unusual here (Narsarsuaq).

clues.title: Google car: black ATV with orange-purple bag
text: On the other side of the fjord from Narsarsuaq, a black ATV with an **orange and purple bag **in the front can be seen. The coverage has a lot of **tall green grass** and the dirt is unusually red for Greenland.
clues.summary: Across the fjord from Narsarsuaq, a black ATV with an orange and purple bag at the front, tall green grass and unusually red dirt.

clues.title: Google car: blue ATV, wide mirrors
text: Qeqertarsuaq is most easily recognized by the **blue ATV **with **wide side mirrors**. The coverage is fairly overcast and with a lot of yellow grass along the roads.
clues.summary: A blue ATV with wide side mirrors, fairly overcast, with lots of yellow grass by the roads (Qeqertarsuaq).

clues.title: Google car: wooden box on ATV, purple beanie
text: Most coverage in Ittoqqortoormiit can be recognized by the brown **wooden box** at the front of the ATV and the driver wearing a **purple beanie**. The ground is mostly grey and stony and the coverage is very sunny.
clues.summary: A brown wooden box at the front of the ATV and a driver in a purple beanie, on grey stony ground in very sunny coverage (Ittoqqortoormiit).

clues.title: Landscape: wide snowy range to the northeast
text: The coverage in and around Igaliku is most easily recognized by the wide, **snow-covered mountain range** to the northeast which looks very bright due to the setting sun. The green ATV, while not entirely unique on its own, can also be a useful hint.
clues.summary: A wide snow-covered mountain range to the northeast, very bright from the setting sun. A green ATV is a helpful extra hint (Igaliku).

clues.title: Google car: round grey car, barely visible
text: Paamiut can typically be recognized by the **round, grey car** which is often only [barely visible](https://www.google.com/maps/@62.0039014,-49.6662114,3a,34.2y,53.14h,54.05t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s-sGrkMSkKSrE0u8GiR0AzQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656). The coverage has a lot of thin clouds, but is still quite bright and the foliage consists of a mixture of yellow and green grass, and reddish moss.
clues.summary: A round grey car, often barely visible, in bright coverage with thin clouds and yellow-green grass with reddish moss (Paamiut).

clues.title: Landscape: streaky clouds, dry, sandy
text: Kangerlussuaq can typically be recognized by the many **streaky clouds** in the sky, combined with the **significant dryness**. The roads near Kangerlussuaq can also be recognized by its [unconventional look](https://goo.gl/maps/aPBPeVSdkdq8d4VD8), with many small bushes, sandy soil with an almost arid climate.
clues.summary: Many streaky clouds and a very dry look, with small bushes and sandy soil that feels almost arid (Kangerlussuaq).

clues.title: Road: large white truck
text: The road east of Kangerlussuaq is easily recognized by the** large white truck**.
clues.summary: The road east of Kangerlussuaq has a large white truck as the Google vehicle.

clues.title: Road: thick snow, sun sets along the road
text: The coverage connecting Sisimiut and Kangerlussuaq is easily recognized by the **thick layer of snow** on and around the road. The sun sets along the road, making the western parts very bright and the eastern parts very dark.
clues.summary: The road linking Sisimiut and Kangerlussuaq has thick snow on and around it. The sun sets along the road, so the west part is very bright and the east part very dark.

clues.title: Landscape: wide cloudy range across a fjord
text: To the north of Saattut you can see a wide mountain range **shrouded in clouds**, on the other side of a fjord. The paths covered are mostly dark, muddy dirt roads, and the foliage is mainly yellow grass tufts.
clues.summary: North of Saattut, a wide mountain range shrouded in clouds across a fjord. Mostly dark muddy dirt roads and yellow grass tufts.

clues.title: Google car: round red ATV, pyramid mountain NE
text: The coverage on Kulusuk island has a **round, red ATV**, with a pyramid shaped mountain often seen to the northeast. The footage was taken right after sunset on a clear day, making it fairly dark.
clues.summary: A round red ATV with a pyramid-shaped mountain often to the northeast. Shot just after sunset, so it is fairly dark (Kulusuk).

clues.title: Coverage: melting snow by roads
text: Kangaatsiaq has a large amount of **thawing snow** on the side of the roads. The sun is setting and there is a large body of water to the west.
clues.summary: Lots of thawing snow beside the roads, the sun setting and a large body of water to the west (Kangaatsiaq).

clues.title: Landscape: huge monolithic mountain to the west
text: Ikerasak is most easily recognized by the large **monolithic mountain** to the west.
clues.summary: A large monolithic mountain to the west identifies Ikerasak.

clues.title: Landscape: tall cliff to the east
text: Ukkusissat is located below a **tall cliffside** to the east with mountains towering above it.
clues.summary: The settlement sits below a tall cliffside to the east, with mountains towering above (Ukkusissat).

clues.title: Landscape: sharp mountain east, round one north
text: Kuummiit can be recognized by **two distinct mountains**, a sharp one to the east and a rounder one to the north. The coverage is slightly dark due to clouds and the sun setting.
clues.summary: Two distinct mountains, a sharp one to the east and a rounder one to the north, in slightly dark light from clouds and sunset (Kuummiit).

clues.title: Houses: grey, on smooth light-grey rocks
text: Unlike most houses in Greenland, the houses in Tiilerilaaq are commonly **grey** rather than colourful. The village can also be recognized by the ground, which is almost entirely made up of smooth, light grey rocks.
clues.summary: Unlike most houses here, these are commonly grey instead of colourful, and the ground is nearly all smooth light grey rocks (Tiilerilaaq).

clues.title: Landscape: large dark grey rocks over the
text: Large, **dark grey rocks** towering over Niaqornat can be used to recognize the village.
clues.summary: Large, dark grey rocks tower over Niaqornat.

clues.title: Landscape: sandy pyramid mountains
text: Siorapaluk can be recognized by the **sandy, pyramid-shaped mountains** to the north, combined with the wide **sand beach** below the village.
NOTE: Look for the store named “Pilersuisoq” to locate the village, as you have to zoom in very far on Google Maps to see the label of the village.
clues.summary: Sandy, pyramid-shaped mountains to the north and a wide sand beach below the village. Look for the shop named Pilersuisoq to find it (Siorapaluk).

clues.title: Landscape: icebergs, bright white range beyond
text: To the southwest of Qaanaaq, you can see icebergs in a large body of water, and a wide mountain range on the other side, where the snow is **bright white** as it reflects the sunlight through the thick clouds.
clues.summary: Southwest of Qaanaaq, icebergs in a large body of water and a wide mountain range beyond, bright white as the snow reflects light through thick clouds.

clues.title: Google car: red and black ATV, snowy mountains
text: A **red and black ATV **can be found in and around the village of Kapisillit, northeast of Nuuk. Many mountains in the distance are covered in a layer of snow.
clues.summary: A red and black ATV in and around Kapisillit, northeast of the capital, with many snow-covered mountains in the distance.

clues.title: Landscape: evenly tall shaped mountains across
text: Kangerluk can be recognized by the evenly tall mountains with a **particular shape** on the other side of the fjord.
clues.summary: Evenly tall mountains of a particular shape on the other side of the fjord (Kangerluk).

clues.title: Coverage: many sharp snow-powdered mountains
text: On a small bit of coverage east of Nuuk you can see a large number of sharp mountains, **powdered in snow**. The coverage is somewhat dark due to the thick clouds and the sun being hidden behind the mountains.
clues.summary: A short piece east of the capital shows many sharp, snow-dusted mountains. It is somewhat dark because of thick clouds and the sun hidden behind the mountains.

clues.title: Coverage: large ice blocks in every direction
text: About 20 km northeast of Narsarsuaq, you can find a small piece of coverage with large **ice blocks** in every direction.
clues.summary: About 20 km northeast of Narsarsuaq there is a small piece of coverage with large ice blocks all around.

clues.title: Road: airport runway, widest paved road
text: In Upernavik, the **airport runway** is covered on Street View, making it by far the widest paved road found on Street View in Greenland.
clues.summary: At Upernavik the airport runway is covered, making it by far the widest paved road in Street View here.

clues.title: Google car: boat, white cabin, red roof
text: This boat, with a **white cabin** and a **red roof**, can be found by a multitude of towns and villages on the west coast. However, most of the coverage is in the general area around the city of Aasiaat.
clues.summary: A boat with a white cabin and red roof, near many west coast towns, though most coverage is around Aasiaat.

clues.title: Google car: boat with red square cabin
text: Similar to the previous boat, this one with a **red square cabin** can be found at multiple locations on the west coast, most significantly by and around Akunnaaq.
clues.summary: A boat with a red square cabin, at multiple spots on the west coast, mostly around Akunnaaq.

clues.title: Google car: boat, black box front
text: A boat with a **black box** near the front, and a **chequered pattern** on the bow can be found fairly north on the east coast. While the western part of the coverage is very foggy and somewhat overcast, the eastern parts of the coverage is slightly less foggy and very sunny. [A man](https://goo.gl/maps/3C9RtCCYvVKgfQGQ9) wearing a black coat can also be seen captaining the boat.
clues.summary: A boat with a black box near the front and a chequered pattern on the bow, far north on the east coast. The west part is foggy and overcast, the east part clearer and sunny. A man in a black coat captains it.

clues.title: Google car: bright red boat
text: This **bright red** boat can be found on the east coast near the towns of Tiilerillaq and Kuummiit respectively. While the coverage near Tiilerillaq does not have a cloud in sight, the coverage near Kuummiit is somewhat overcast.
clues.summary: A bright red boat on the east coast near Tiilerillaq (no clouds) and Kuummiit (somewhat overcast).

clues.title: Google car: black-and-white boat, blue roof
text: A black and white boat, with a **blue roof**, is found between the towns of Kuummiit and Tasiilaq.
clues.summary: A black and white boat with a blue roof, between Kuummiit and Tasiilaq.

clues.title: Google car: small white boat, brown wooden top
text: This small white boat, with a **brown wooden top** and lights and monitoring devices, can be seen between Tiilerilaaq and Tasiilaq.
clues.summary: A small white boat with a brown wooden top and lights and monitoring devices, between Tiilerilaaq and Tasiilaq.

clues.title: Google car: boat with small rounded red bow
text: A small, **rounded red bow** can be found on a boat going south of Tasiilaq.
clues.summary: A small, rounded red bow on a boat going south of Tasiilaq.

clues.title: Google car: small red-black boat with several
text: This small, **red and black** boat, with multiple people sitting in it, can be found in a fjord far north on the east coast.
clues.summary: A small red and black boat with several people sitting in it, in a fjord far north on the east coast.

clues.title: Google car: wooden fishing boat
text: This **wooden fishing boat **is found outside Ilulissat.
clues.summary: A wooden fishing boat found outside Ilulissat.

clues.title: Google car: small white boat, silver bow rail
text: This small, white boat with a **silver handrail** on the bow can be found west of Narsaq and east of Qaqortoq. While the sun is in the west on the coverage near Narsaq, it is in the east on the coverage near Qaqortoq.
clues.summary: A small white boat with a silver handrail on the bow, between Narsaq and Qaqortoq. The sun is in the west near Narsaq and in the east near Qaqortoq.

clues.title: Google car: large all-white boat
text: This large, **all white** boat can be seen in between Narsarsuaq with the opposing shore.
clues.summary: A large, all-white boat between Narsarsuaq and the opposite shore.

clues.title: Google car: grey boat
text: A **grey** boat is found east of Nuuk.
clues.summary: A grey boat east of the capital.

clues.title: Google car: mostly white boat
text: A mostly white boat, with **extremely tall antennas** on the rear can be found going into the fjord east of Nuuk.

images.caption: A mostly white boat used as the Street View vehicle on the water

clues.summary: A mostly white boat with extremely tall antennas at the back, going into the fjord east of the capital.

clues.title: Coverage: many different vehicles
text: Coverage in Greenland was taken with many different vehicles. Architecture and landscape look very similar all over Greenland but it's hard to put it in words but it's pretty recognizable that's why I included it in this map.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.summary: Many different vehicles took the coverage. Architecture and landscape look alike all over the country, and the overall feel is recognisable once you have seen it.
